metadata.chunk_title: How to Apply for a funded place + Types of funding available + Funding for the individual + Springboard+: 90 –100% Funding Available + What is it?

facts.value: The Springboard+ offers 90% funding for those who are employed and 100% funding for those who are unemployed or engaging in a NFQ Level 6 programme.

metadata.chunk_title: How to Apply for a funded place + Types of funding available + Funding for the individual + Springboard+: 90 –100% Funding Available + What is it?

facts.value: There are a limited number of funded Springboard+ places available across pre-selected programmes in UL. They are offered on a first come first served basis.

metadata.chunk_title: How to Apply for a funded place + Types of funding available + Funding for the individual + Springboard+: 90 –100% Funding Available + What is it?

facts.value: First find and register for your course on https://springboardcourses.ie/. Springboard+ will notify the University of Limerick that you have applied, and you will receive an email within 2-5 working days inviting you to apply directly on the University of Limerick website. Check your spam regularly to avoid missing this email.
